import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000010;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long p, k, ans = 1;
    static int[] vis = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN];

    static void dfs(long n, int l) {
        if (vis[(int) n] == 1) {
            f[l]++;
            return;
        }
        vis[(int) n] = 1;
        long nextN = (n * k) % p;
        dfs(nextN, l + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k != 0 && k != 1) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                if (vis[i] == 0) {
                    dfs(i, 0);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= f[i]; j++) {
                    ans = (ans * (f[i] * i + 1)) % MOD;
                }
            }
        } else if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }
        } else if (k == 1) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
